name: Burundi

flag.description: A white saltire divides the field into red triangles at top and bottom and green triangles at hoist and fly; a white disc in the centre holds three red six-pointed stars outlined in green.
flag.symbolism: Red stands for the struggle for independence, green for hope and white for peace; the three stars represent the Hutu, Twa and Tutsi peoples and the motto 'Unity, Work, Progress'.

hook: Burundi's flag is a big white X with a white disc holding three red stars: three syllables, Bu-run-di, three stars.
trivia: The three stars echo the national motto 'Unité, Travail, Progrès' as well as the country's three main ethnic groups.
In 2019 Gitega replaced Bujumbura as the political capital; Bujumbura remains the economic centre.
